description: This file defines classes and functions for managing quarantine rules for tests, including loading data from YAML files, matching tests against quarantine criteria, and handling quarantine exceptions.

classes.name: QuarantineException
classes.description: Custom exception class for quarantine-related errors.

classes.name: Quarantine
classes.description: Handles quarantine rules, loading data, and matching tests to quarantine criteria.

classes.name: QuarantineElement
classes.description: Represents a quarantine rule with filters for scenarios, platforms, architectures, and simulations.

classes.name: QuarantineData
classes.description: Holds a list of quarantine elements and provides methods to load and extend quarantine data.

methods.name: Quarantine.__init__
methods.description: Initializes quarantine object with a list of YAML files.

methods.name: Quarantine.get_matched_quarantine
methods.description: Returns the quarantine element matching given test parameters.

methods.name: QuarantineElement.__post_init__
methods.description: Post-initialization to compile regex patterns and handle 'all' keywords.

methods.name: QuarantineData.__post_init__
methods.description: Converts raw data into QuarantineElement instances.

methods.name: QuarantineData.load_data_from_yaml
methods.description: Loads quarantine data from a YAML file.

methods.name: QuarantineData.extend
methods.description: Extends the quarantine list with additional data.

methods.name: QuarantineData.get_matched_quarantine
methods.description: Finds a quarantine rule that matches given test parameters.

methods.name: _is_element_matched
methods.description: Checks if an element matches any regex pattern in a list.
